description_en: Retrieves the basic configuration information of a specified China domain name for video-on-demand (VOD) acceleration
description_zh: 调用本接口获取指定点播域名配置的基本信息
name: DescribeVodDomainDetail

DomainDetail.description_en: The basic configuration information of the domain name

CertName.description_en: The name of the HTTPS certificate. This parameter is returned only if HTTPS secure acceleration is enabled
CertName.description_zh: 如果开启HTTPS安全加速，此处为HTTPS证书的名称；如果未开启HTTPS安全加速，则不返回此参数

Cname.description_en: The CNAME assigned to the accelerated domain name. You must add a CNAME record with your DNS provider to map the accelerated domain name to this CNAME. For more information, see [Configure a CNAME record]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86075.html）
Cname.description_zh: 为加速域名生成的一个CNAME域名，需要在域名解析服务商处将此加速域名CNAME解析到该域名。详细操作请参见[配置CNAME]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86075.html）

Description.description_en: The description of the VOD acceleration domain name

DomainStatus.description_en:
The status of the accelerated domain name. Valid values:

online: enabled.
offline: disabled.
configuring: being configured.
configure_failed: configuration failed.
checking: being reviewed.
check_failed: review failed
DomainStatus.description_zh:
加速域名运行状态。取值意义：

online：表示启用。
offline：表示停用。
configuring：表示配置中。
configure_failed：表示配置失败。
checking：表示正在审核。
check_failed：表示审核失败

GmtCreated.description_en: The time when the domain name was created. The time follows the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the domain name was last modified. The time follows the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC

SSLProtocol.description_en:
Indicates whether the SSL certificate is enabled. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
SSLProtocol.description_zh:
是否开启SSL证书。取值：

on：开启。
off：关闭

SSLPub.description_en: The public key of the HTTPS certificate. This parameter is returned only if HTTPS secure acceleration is enabled
SSLPub.description_zh: 如果开启HTTPS安全加速，此处为HTTPS证书的公钥；如果未开启HTTPS安全加速，则不返回此参数

Scope.description_en:
The acceleration region. Valid values:

domestic (default): the Chinese mainland only.
overseas: global (excluding the Chinese mainland).
global: global
Scope.description_zh:
加速区域。取值：

domestic（默认）：仅中国内地。
overseas：全球（不包含中国内地）。
global：全球

items.description_en: The details of the origin server

Enabled.description_en:
The status of the origin server. Valid values:

online: enabled.
offline: disabled
Enabled.description_zh:
源站状态。取值：

online：启用。
offline：停用

Type.description_en:
The type of the origin server. Valid values:

ipaddr: an IP address.
domain: a domain name.
oss: an OSS bucket
Type.description_zh:
源站类型。取值：

ipaddr：IP源站。
domain：域名源站。
oss：OSS Bucket为源站
